back.target: to fit (be the right size or shape)
back.example: The jacket doesn't fit me anymore.

note: The Spanish card quedar-suit ("to suit (clothes on someone)") is close, but it means looking good on someone, which is German stehen, not being the right size, so null is the right choice; the hint is needed to keep this card apart from the word's "to suit" (be convenient) card.
